notes:
Video Studio now accepts screenplays. Paste into the video prompt or open Make a movie from a script. Choose Cartoon, Cinematic or Follow script. Workbench estimates the finished runtime and local render time, generates the scenes in order, speaks character dialogue with locally installed voices and burns synchronized subtitles into the MP4. Long scripts render as multiple shots and are assembled into one movie. Verified parts of movies longer than three minutes can be reused when continuing an interrupted job.

For individual clips, Length appears below Frame. Every whole-second duration from 1 second to 3 minutes shows an estimated render time. Recent quality renders calibrate the estimates on that PC.

Workbench reuses exact text encodings and keeps shared model operations available across connected shots. A four-second beach scene rendered on a 12 GB RTX 3060 in 256.5 seconds, compared with 299.4 seconds for the original saved render and 262.9 seconds for a fresh run with the previous settings. The optimized MP4 matched the original SHA-256. Other prompts and hardware will vary.

A controlled 184-second screenplay test exercised scene cuts, interrupted rendering, reuse of completed segments and whole-movie assembly. The native Video tests and the browser composer tests passed.
